topic: propeller-openwater-bem / KP505 official open-water data transcription

criteria.statement: every data point carries a verbatim quotation and a table number

measured.quote_all_points: Table 2. Comparison of CFD and Experimental Results

criteria.statement: >= 8 advance-ratio points, design advance ratio included
eta0 = J*KT/(2*pi*KQ) recomputed from the tabulated KT, 10KQ; peak J recorded explicitly

honest_notes: PROVENANCE GAP (honest): the primary KRISO/KCS-workshop EFD handout and the Hino (2005) Tokyo-2015 proceedings were not reachable from this sandbox (egress allowlist). The transcribed curve is a SECONDARY reproduction: the 'Experimental' columns of Table 2 of Iftikhar & Takinaci, MARINE 2023.

That paper does not cite the source of its experimental column, so the anchor is labelled SECONDARY_REPRODUCTION and must be re-verified against the KRISO table before it is used for an accuracy claim in the parent study.
Geometry: D and blade count are taken from/measured on the official KRISO geometry archive; P/D and AE/A0 are WITHHELD (no reachable official textual source).

source.citation: H. Iftikhar, A. C. Takinaci, 'Performance Prediction of KP505 Propeller Using Lifting Line Theory and RANS', X International Conference on Computational Methods in Marine Engineering (MARINE 2023), CIMNE, DOI 10.23967/marine.2023.120
source.table: Table 2. Comparison of CFD and Experimental Results (columns 'Experimental')
source.quote: Table 2. Comparison of CFD and Experimental Results

source_consistency_checks.note: the source's own error columns reproduce from its own CFD/EFD columns

diameter_m.evidence: official KCS workshop geometry archive member 'KP505/KP505_modelScale_250mm.igs' (link text 'Propeller Geometory' on t2015.nmri.go.jp/kcs_gc.html) states the model diameter D = 250 mm; independently quoted from the source paper Table 1 (page 6): 'Diameter (m) 0.25'

P_over_D.evidence: the only reachable statement is the source paper Table 1 (page 6): 'P/D (mean) 0.950', which is not confirmed by any official document reachable here and is not used as a criterion value; deriving P/D from the IGES needs blade-section pitch angles (not done in this deliverable)

AE_over_A0.evidence: the only reachable statement is the source paper Table 1 (page 6): 'Ae/Ao 0.800', conflicting with the workshop geometry package and with the value commonly quoted for KP505; the developed-area ratio cannot be measured on the 3-D surface without un-wrapping cylindrical sections, so it stays WITHHELD

measurement_attempt.why: the IGES NURBS control-point cage is not a surface point cloud; the measured tip radius (220.2 file units) exceeds the documented model radius (125 mm) and the near-tip angular histogram resolves only 2 clusters, so neither D nor Z is taken from this measurement

measured.unit_note: IGES global section: '2HMM,1.0' -> model units are millimetres, factor 1.0
